summary: Practise research design, market sizing, source checks, and reporting. Explore the five-day foundation course and find the right fit.
lede: Market intelligence training helps research, marketing and commercial teams turn customer, market and competitor questions into decision-ready evidence. Learners practise writing research briefs, selecting qualitative or quantitative methods, designing questionnaires, and documenting sampling limits. They also validate sources, analyse practice survey data in Excel, and present findings as concise recommendations with clear assumptions and limitations.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who collect, commission, analyse, or use customer and market evidence. It is designed for roles that need to translate commercial questions into proportionate research and communicate findings without overstating what the evidence shows.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a customer, product, service, or commercial decision is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring access to Excel for the survey-analysis exercises.
topics: Data collection, survey design & mobile tools
Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
